items.title: Angola Talking Interview, 1959-03-15
items.q: INTERVIEWER: Oh, yes. I've been moved away from Zachary, Louisiana since 28. ... I was born and raised there in Zachary

ctx.x: Oh, yes. I've been moved away from Zachary, Louisiana since 28. And I've been around, let's say, Baton Rouge ever since. Yes. I was born and raised there in Zachary, but we left there in 28 and we've been living there in Baton Rouge.
Well, I would say that Zachary's, that's the fourth wall. Fourth, that's the fourth wall. Because Baton Rouge is third. Zachary would be fourth. It's north of Baton Rouge. Yes. North of Baton Rouge.
